c2-act-0033: Paul stands to speak. Stay with Acts 13:16.
c2-act-0034: Paul and Barnabas keep going in their work. Stay with Acts 14:1 and Acts 13:9.
c3-gal-0010: Paul tells more of his story. Stay with Galatians 2:2 and Galatians 1:18.
c3-rom-0021: Paul speaks of those he owes. He also gives thanks for the believers in Rome. Stay with Romans 1:14 and Romans 1:8.
c3-1co-0010: Paul speaks of whom he baptized. He also mentions a report that came to him. Stay with First Corinthians 1:16 and First Corinthians 1:11.
c3-act-0035: The travelers come to a new place, and the word is received. Paul also later calls the elders. Stay with Acts 17:11 and Acts 20:17.
c3-act-0036: Unusual things happen through Paul in Ephesus. The travelers also later stay in a home. Stay with Acts 19:12 and Acts 21:8.
c3-act-0037: Paul tells of his youth in the city. A later letter is also written. Stay with Acts 22:3 and Acts 23:26.
c3-act-0038: Paul speaks before the court. A later judgment is also given. Stay with Acts 25:10 and Acts 26:32.
c3-act-0039: The ship sails along the coast. Paul also later travels on from one place. Stay with Acts 27:5 and Acts 18:1.
c2-eph-0008: Paul speaks of the grace given to us. Stay with Ephesians 1:8.
c2-eph-0009: Paul speaks of our redemption. He also speaks of God's rich mercy. Stay with Ephesians 1:7 and Ephesians 2:4.
c3-eph-0010: Paul speaks of a hope in Christ. He also writes as a prisoner. Stay with Ephesians 1:12 and Ephesians 3:1.
c3-eph-0011: Paul speaks of the Gentiles' place in Christ. He also reminds them of the life God gave. Stay with Ephesians 3:6 and Ephesians 2:1.
c3-eph-0012: Paul turns to prayer. He also asks them to keep the unity of the Spirit. Stay with Ephesians 3:14 and Ephesians 4:3.
c3-eph-0013: Paul speaks of peace in Christ. He also speaks of the promised Holy Spirit. Stay with Ephesians 2:14 and Ephesians 1:14.
c3-eph-0014: Paul speaks of the Father's plan for us. He also praises the One who can do far more. Stay with Ephesians 1:5 and Ephesians 3:20.
c3-eph-0015: The Lord gives gifts to His people. They are also built together as a dwelling for God. Stay with Ephesians 4:11 and Ephesians 2:22.
c3-eph-0016: Paul blesses God for His kindness to us. He also asks them to walk with a gentle heart. Stay with Ephesians 1:3 and Ephesians 4:2.
c3-eph-0017: Paul prays they will know the love of Christ. He also speaks of one body and one Spirit. Stay with Ephesians 3:18 and Ephesians 4:4.
c2-php-0016: Paul tells why he thinks of them this way. Stay with Philippians 1:7.
c2-col-0005: Paul greets the believers. He also later asks them to keep praying. Stay with Colossians 1:2 and Colossians 4:2.
c3-php-0003: Paul prays their love will abound more and more. Sit with Philippians 1:10 and Philippians 1:9.
c3-phm-0006: Paul closes with a blessing of grace. He also sends greetings from a fellow prisoner. Stay with Philemon 1:25 and Philemon 1:23.
c3-act-0040: Paul explains why he is in custody. The travelers have also arrived in the city. Stay with Acts 28:20 and Acts 28:16.
c3-eph-0019: Paul sends a closing blessing. He also began the letter by naming the saints. Stay with Ephesians 6:23 and Ephesians 1:1.
c3-col-0006: Paul tells them how to walk with wisdom. He also gives thanks to the Father. Stay with Colossians 4:5 and Colossians 1:12.
c3-php-0004: Paul writes to this church. He also thanks God for their fellowship in the gospel. Stay with Philippians 1:1 and Philippians 1:5.
c3-act-0041: Paul keeps teaching in the city. An earlier hearing is also remembered. Stay with Acts 28:31 and Acts 28:18.
c3-php-0005: Paul speaks of his love for them. He also greets them with grace and peace. Stay with Philippians 1:8 and Philippians 1:2.
c2-1ti-0005: Paul gives thanks for the Lord's kindness to him. Stay with First Timothy 1:12.
c2-1ti-0006: Paul gives a warning about who should lead. He also warns against empty talk. Stay with First Timothy 3:6 and First Timothy 1:4.
c3-1ti-0007: Paul describes who may lead. He also says the law is good when used well. Stay with First Timothy 3:2 and First Timothy 1:8.
c3-2ti-0006: Paul adds another word of counsel. He also calls Timothy a good soldier of Jesus Christ. Stay with Second Timothy 2:5 and Second Timothy 2:3.
c3-2ti-0007: Paul is nearly alone. He also asks Timothy for a few things. Stay with Second Timothy 4:11 and Second Timothy 4:13.
c3-1ti-0008: Paul writes about a real concern. He also speaks of the mystery of godliness. Stay with First Timothy 1:7 and First Timothy 3:16.
c3-1ti-0009: Paul gives Timothy work to do there. He also praises the One who lives in light. Stay with First Timothy 1:3 and First Timothy 6:16.
c3-1ti-0010: Paul speaks of a leader's home. He also tells Timothy to guard what was trusted. Stay with First Timothy 3:4 and First Timothy 6:20.
c3-2ti-0008: Paul speaks of a hard season. He also shares a faithful saying. Stay with Second Timothy 1:12 and Second Timothy 2:11.
c3-2ti-0009: The trustworthy saying continues. He also asks Timothy to come, and sends greetings. Stay with Second Timothy 2:12 and Second Timothy 4:21.
c2-php-0006: Paul's chains have made something clear. Stay with Philippians 1:13.
c2-php-0007: Paul tells them about what has happened to him. Another verse speaks of those who preach. Stay with Philippians 1:12 and Philippians 1:17.
c3-php-0008: Christ humbled Himself. He also did not cling to His place. Stay with Philippians 2:8 and Philippians 2:6.
c3-php-0009: People preach Christ with a wrong heart. Paul also speaks of reasons for confidence in the flesh. Stay with Philippians 1:15 and Philippians 3:4.
c3-php-0010: Paul speaks of the race still ahead. He also hopes their joy in Christ will be greater. Stay with Philippians 3:12 and Philippians 1:26.
c3-php-0011: Paul's chains have had an effect on others. He also gives a sharp warning. Stay with Philippians 1:14 and Philippians 3:2.
c3-php-0012: Paul speaks of his longing. God has also highly exalted Christ. Stay with Philippians 1:23 and Philippians 2:9.
c3-php-0013: Some do not preach with a true heart. Paul also speaks of the prize ahead. Stay with Philippians 1:16 and Philippians 3:14.
c3-php-0014: Paul rethinks what he once valued. He also trusts this will turn out for his deliverance. Stay with Philippians 3:7 and Philippians 1:19.
c3-php-0015: Paul keeps his eyes on one aim. He also expects to remain with them. Stay with Philippians 3:13 and Philippians 1:25.
c2-heb-0013: The Son has loved righteousness. Stay with Hebrews 1:9.
c2-heb-0014: Creation will not last as it is. The world to come is also spoken of. Stay with Hebrews 1:12 and Hebrews 2:5.
c3-heb-0015: We belong to the same family in Christ. The letter also asks them to consider Jesus. Stay with Hebrews 2:11 and Hebrews 3:1.
c3-heb-0016: Jesus is set beside Moses in this letter. He also learned obedience through what He suffered. Stay with Hebrews 3:2 and Hebrews 5:8.
c3-heb-0017: This priest meets Abraham in the story. Jesus has also become the source of eternal deliverance. Stay with Hebrews 7:4 and Hebrews 5:9.
c3-heb-0018: Angels have a work to do for God's people. The Son also speaks of His brethren. Stay with Hebrews 1:14 and Hebrews 2:12.
c3-heb-0019: We are the house of the Son. The Father also speaks to the Son of His throne. Stay with Hebrews 3:6 and Hebrews 1:8.
c3-heb-0020: The priest's line is carefully named. This One has also been counted worthy of more glory than Moses. Stay with Hebrews 7:13 and Hebrews 3:3.
c3-heb-0021: The priests keep their daily work. It is also clear which tribe our Lord came from. Stay with Hebrews 10:11 and Hebrews 7:14.
c3-heb-0022: Another word from Scripture is shared. Jesus has also become the surety of a better covenant. Stay with Hebrews 2:13 and Hebrews 7:22.
c2-rom-0022: Paul speaks of what God has shown in Christ. Stay with Romans 3:25.
c2-2co-0009: The love of Christ constrains us. Paul also speaks of a new way to live. Stay with Second Corinthians 5:16 and Second Corinthians 5:14.
c3-gal-0011: Paul continues this argument. He also speaks of what the law requires. Stay with Galatians 3:11 and Galatians 3:12.
c3-heb-0023: The writer explains this further. The first covenant also comes up. Stay with Hebrews 9:16 and Hebrews 9:18.
c3-1pe-0009: Christ suffered for us and left us an example. Stay with First Peter 2:22 and First Peter 2:21.
c3-rom-0023: God shows His righteousness in the present time. It is also now revealed apart from the law. Stay with Romans 3:26 and Romans 3:21.
c3-2co-0010: Christ died for all, that those who live should live for Him. Stay with Second Corinthians 5:21 and Second Corinthians 5:15.
c3-1pe-0010: When He was reviled, He did not revile in return. Stay with First Peter 2:24 and First Peter 2:23.
c3-heb-0024: Christ was offered once for many. He will also appear a second time. Stay with Hebrews 9:15 and Hebrews 9:28.
c3-heb-0025: A limit is set on human life. The heavenly things also needed a better sacrifice. Stay with Hebrews 9:27 and Hebrews 9:23.
